title: Philadelphia: Pressed Flower Art Workshop
blurb:
Pressed Flower Art Workshop 
Looking for a meaningful and creative travel experience in Philadelphia? ✨
Our Pressed Flower Art Workshop offers a peaceful escape where you'll craft a beautiful floral design using real pressed flowers and greenery. Guided by our friendly instructors, you'll arrange your own 8x10 masterpiece in a floating glass frame - no experience needed!
Everything is provided: archival-safe glue, materials, and plenty of floral inspiration. Just show up, relax, and let your creativity bloom!
Take home a stunning, nature-inspired piece that captures the moment - perfect for your home or as a thoughtful gift. 
 A one-of-a-kind hands-on experience
️ Great for solo travelers, couples, or small groups
 A calming, screen-free break during your trip
 Located in Philadelphia’s creative hub
 Duration: 1.5 hours - short, sweet, and unforgettable!
